    Physicochemical properties of proteins

    Source: R/bio-sequence.R
    bio_aa_props.Rd

    Calculates sequence-based protein properties used for protein engineering and expression screening: length, average molecular weight (Da), isoelectric point and net charge at pH 7 (EMBOSS pKa values), GRAVY hydropathy (Kyte and Doolittle, 1982), aromaticity and the fractions of acidic, basic and hydrophobic residues. Non-standard residues are ignored and a trailing stop (*) is dropped.

    Usage

    bio_aa_props(.data, seq = NULL, prefix = "")

    Arguments

    .data

    A data frame, tibble or bio_seq_tbl().

    seq

    <tidy-select> The sequence column. Can be omitted for a <bio_seq_tbl>.

    prefix

    Prefix for the new column names.

    Value

    .data with nine numeric columns: length, mol_weight, isoelectric_point, charge_ph7, gravy, aromaticity, frac_acidic, frac_basic and frac_hydrophobic, each with prefix.

    References

    Kyte, J. and Doolittle, R. F. (1982). A simple method for displaying the hydropathic character of a protein. Journal of Molecular Biology, 157, 105-132. doi:10.1016/0022-2836(82)90515-0

    Examples

    ecoli_cds |>
  dplyr::slice(1:5) |>
  bio_aa_props(protein) |>
  dplyr::select(gene, length, mol_weight, isoelectric_point, gravy)
#> # A tibble: 5 × 5
#>   gene  length mol_weight isoelectric_point  gravy
#>   <chr>  <dbl>      <dbl>             <dbl>  <dbl>
#> 1 rplA     234     24730.              10.3 -0.109
#> 2 rplB     273     29860.              11.6 -0.699
#> 3 rplC     209     22244.              10.7 -0.235
#> 4 rplD     201     22087.              10.4 -0.235
#> 5 rplE     179     20302.              10.0 -0.282
